upsert.funding: NC State states that enrolled dogs receive free treatment including bloodwork, biopsy, CT scan, radiation therapy, and limb-amputation surgery. Owners are encouraged to pursue postoperative chemotherapy; the study will facilitate a referral, but the public flyer does not state that postoperative chemotherapy is covered.

The CARE glioma trial covers all study procedures and provides $4,000 toward standard radiation therapy. The owner remains responsible for radiation costs above that contribution and other expenses not covered by the study.

The PRISM glioma study provides $3,000 toward either the initial diagnostic workup or radiation treatment, depending on the study pathway, and covers trial-related follow-up care. Families remain responsible for expenses not covered by the study.
